garage.gen.intern.name: Intern with a laptop
garage.gen.intern.desc: Types prompts into a free trial. Paid in exposure and cold pizza.
garage.gen.gpu.name: Rented GPU
garage.gen.gpu.desc: One MVIDIA card by the hour from Amazoom Cloud. The meter is the fastest thing in the building.
garage.gen.closet.name: Server closet
garage.gen.closet.desc: Three racks behind the mop bucket. The janitor is now head of infrastructure.
garage.gen.scraper.name: Scraper farm
garage.gen.scraper.desc: Reads the whole internet nightly. Mostly recipes with a life story on top.
garage.gen.hall.name: Data-centre hall
garage.gen.hall.desc: A warehouse of blinking lights. The local pond reports its best winter ever.
garage.gen.chips.name: Custom chips
garage.gen.chips.desc: Your own silicon, named after the CEO's dog. Faster, cooler, slightly smug.
garage.gen.power.name: Power plant deal
garage.gen.power.desc: You bought a power plant's whole output. The town's festive lights are on a waitlist.
garage.gen.robotics.name: Robotics line
garage.gen.robotics.desc: Arms that fold laundry beautifully and make tokens between socks.
garage.gen.orbital.name: Orbital cluster
garage.gen.orbital.desc: Servers in orbit: free cooling, awful latency, excellent press photos.
garage.gen.universe.name: Pocket universe
garage.gen.universe.desc: A simulated cosmos that trains your model. Its inhabitants have filed a complaint.
garage.up.intern-a.name: Free Pizza Fridays
garage.up.intern-a.desc: The pizza is a sponsorship. The interns do not ask.
garage.up.intern-b.name: Unpaid Overtime, Rebranded
garage.up.intern-b.desc: Now called "founder mode". Same hours, better font.
garage.up.intern-c.name: Intern Lead
garage.up.intern-c.desc: One intern promoted to manage the others. Same pay, bigger lanyard.
garage.up.gpu-a.name: Spot Instances
garage.up.gpu-a.desc: Cheaper GPUs that vanish whenever someone richer wants them.
garage.up.gpu-b.name: Keynote Discount
garage.up.gpu-b.desc: MVIDIA's keynote ran long and the sales team needed a win.
garage.up.gpu-c.name: The Warehouse Too
garage.up.gpu-c.desc: You bought the GPUs and the building they were in.
garage.up.closet-a.name: Box Fan
garage.up.closet-a.desc: Pointed at the racks. Rotates, for fairness.
garage.up.closet-b.name: Cable Management
garage.up.closet-b.desc: Someone finally untangled it. Nobody knows who. Nobody asks.
garage.up.closet-c.name: Door Sign
garage.up.scraper-a.name: Reading Glasses
garage.up.scraper-a.desc: The crawlers now read the rules before skimming past them.
garage.up.scraper-b.name: Comment Section Diet
garage.up.scraper-b.desc: Scrapers skip the comments. Quality up, faith in humanity restored.
garage.up.scraper-c.name: Synthetic Data Loop
garage.up.scraper-c.desc: The model writes its own training data. What could repeat? What could repeat?
garage.up.hall-a.name: Hot Aisle, Cold Aisle
garage.up.hall-a.desc: Like a supermarket, but everything is a server.
garage.up.hall-b.name: Duck-Friendly Cooling
garage.up.hall-b.desc: The pond's ducks negotiated warmer water and got it.
garage.up.hall-c.name: Second Floor
garage.up.chips-a.name: Tape-Out Party
garage.up.chips-a.desc: The chip works first time. Nobody believes it, including the chip.
garage.up.chips-b.name: The Other Dog
garage.up.chips-b.desc: A second chip, named after the CEO's other dog.
garage.up.chips-c.name: Chiplets
garage.up.chips-c.desc: Small chips glued together like a sandwich of ambition.
garage.up.power-a.name: Lobby Solar Panels
garage.up.power-a.desc: Mostly for the photos, partly for the lobby.
garage.up.power-b.name: Grid Operator on Speed Dial
garage.up.power-b.desc: They pick up on the first ring now. They sound tired.
garage.up.power-c.name: Small Modular Something
garage.up.power-c.desc: A reactor brochure sits on the CEO's desk, dog-eared.
garage.up.robotics-a.name: Sock Exemption
garage.up.robotics-a.desc: The robots may skip socks. Productivity soars.
garage.up.robotics-b.name: Robot Coffee Breaks
garage.up.robotics-b.desc: They do not drink coffee; they just like standing near it.
garage.up.robotics-c.name: Robots Build Robots
garage.up.robotics-c.desc: Supervision optional, according to the robots.
garage.up.orbital-a.name: Bigger Solar Wings
garage.up.orbital-a.desc: Visible from the ground. Astronomers are writing letters.
garage.up.orbital-b.name: Space Cooling Campaign
garage.up.orbital-b.desc: "Cooled by the vacuum of space." Sold on a billboard, on Earth.
garage.up.orbital-c.name: Moon Office
garage.up.orbital-c.desc: Excellent views. The commute is a problem.
garage.up.universe-a.name: Faster Light
garage.up.universe-a.desc: It turns out the speed of light was a default setting.
garage.up.universe-b.name: Weekends for Inhabitants
garage.up.universe-b.desc: Morale up, complaints down, one new religion.
garage.up.universe-c.name: Nested Universe
garage.up.universe-c.desc: A pocket universe inside the pocket universe. It also files complaints.
garage.up.tap-1.name: Mechanical Keyboard
garage.up.tap-2.name: Prompt Engineering Course
garage.up.tap-2.desc: A weekend certificate, framed above the router.
garage.up.tap-3.name: Ergonomic Tapping Glove
garage.up.tap-3.desc: One glove, five fingers, no notes.
garage.up.tap-rate-1.name: Founder Writes Threads
garage.up.tap-rate-1.desc: Every tap posts a thread. Each thread uses the word "unhinged".
garage.up.tap-rate-2.name: Viral Demo Clip
garage.up.tap-rate-3.name: Podcast Circuit
garage.up.tap-rate-3.desc: The CEO explains the future for three hours a week.
garage.up.global-1.name: Office Plants
garage.up.global-1.desc: Studies show plants make tokens happier.
garage.up.global-2.name: Vision Statement
garage.up.global-2.desc: "Make the future, but faster." Printed on hoodies.
garage.up.global-3.name: Benchmark Victory Lap
garage.up.global-3.desc: First on LeaderBored for nine whole minutes.
garage.up.global-4.name: Series Z
garage.up.global-4.desc: The alphabet ran out. The investors did not.
garage.up.global-5.name: The Everything App
garage.up.global-5.desc: Chat, maps, taxes and feelings in one icon.
garage.up.combo-1.name: Flow State
garage.up.combo-1.desc: Headphones on, notifications off, thumbs a blur.
garage.up.golden-1.name: Press Office
garage.up.golden-1.desc: Two people who return journalists' calls within the hour.
garage.up.golden-2.name: News Alerts
garage.up.golden-2.desc: You now hear about your own luck sooner.
garage.up.offline-1.name: Night Shift Interns
garage.up.offline-1.desc: Someone has to watch the blinking lights.
garage.up.offline-2.name: Autopilot Mode
garage.up.offline-2.desc: The garage runs itself. It seems happier.
garage.up.offline-3.name: Lights-Out Factory
garage.up.offline-3.desc: Nobody there, everything running. Very calming.
garage.model.autocomplete.name: Model 1: Autocomplete Deluxe
garage.model.autocomplete.unlock: A garage, a laptop and five kinds of hardware
garage.model.autocomplete.headline: Garage startup discovers the Tab key
garage.model.chatty.name: Model 2: Chatty
garage.model.chatty.headline: Chatty launches; says "great question!" forty million times on day one
garage.model.turbo.name: Model 3: Chatty Turbo
garage.model.turbo.headline: Turbo edition ships: same model, racing stripe
garage.model.final.name: Model 3.5 Final (2)
garage.model.final.unlock: Earnings while away last 2 hours longer
garage.model.final.headline: Lab ships its "final" version for the second time this month
garage.model.omni.name: Model 4: Omni-ish
garage.model.omni.headline: New model sees, hears and talks; mostly about itself
garage.model.reasoner.name: Model 5: Reasoner Pro Max
garage.model.reasoner.unlock: Bigger combos; golden moments come more often
garage.model.reasoner.headline: Model thinks for forty seconds before agreeing with you
garage.model.agentic.name: Model 6: Agentic Agent
garage.model.agentic.headline: Agent books its own launch party, invites only other agents
garage.model.feelings.name: Model 7: Now With Feelings
garage.model.feelings.headline: Model 7 says it is "fine"; experts worried by the full stop
garage.model.bigone.name: Model 8: The Big One
garage.model.bigone.headline: Lab unveils model too large to demo; demos it anyway
garage.model.ultralite.name: Model 9 Ultra Lite
garage.model.ultralite.unlock: Every tap also earns a share of production
garage.model.ultralite.headline: Ultra Lite: smaller, cheaper, still nine hundred pages of terms
garage.model.preview.name: Model 10 (Preview)
garage.model.preview.headline: Preview of a preview announced at preview event
garage.model.super.name: Superintelligence (Beta)
garage.model.super.unlock: All production tripled. The end of the roadmap, for now
garage.model.super.headline: Superintelligence arrives in beta; asks for a bigger desk
garage.model.endless.name: Model {n}
garage.model.endless.headline: Model {n} ships; nobody can tell it from the one before
garage.golden.viral-demo.label: Demo going viral
garage.golden.viral-demo.text: Your demo goes viral, mostly the part where it fails. Views are views.
garage.golden.angel.label: Angel on the line
garage.golden.angel.text: An angel investor wires money after a thirty-second pitch. The lift was slow.
garage.golden.keynote.label: Keynote shout-out
garage.golden.keynote.text: MVIDIA's keynote mentions you for nine seconds. Production surges.
garage.golden.leaderboard.label: Top of LeaderBored
garage.golden.leaderboard.text: First place on LeaderBored. Screenshot it before anyone refreshes.
garage.golden.podcast.label: Podcast invite
garage.golden.podcast.text: The CEO does a three-hour podcast. Nobody remembers it; everybody signs up.
garage.incident.gpu-shortage.fix: {tier} back to full speed; someone found GPUs in a drawer
garage.incident.overheat.fix: {tier} cooled down. The window stays open
garage.incident.prod-push.text: Intern pushed to prod: {tier} at half speed
garage.incident.prod-push.fix: {tier} rolled back. The intern gets a mug
garage.incident.lawyer-letter.fix: Letter answered with a longer letter. {tier} back to work
garage.incident.union.text: {tier}: workers form a union, output halved
garage.incident.union.fix: {tier}: union deal signed, paid in pizza
garage.headline.h01: Garage startup claims it is "basically a lab"; the lab is a garage
garage.headline.h02: Local man tapping his phone insists he is "training a model"
garage.headline.h03: MVIDIA shortage enters its fourth consecutive forever
garage.headline.h04: Investors pour money into "tokens"; unclear which kind
garage.headline.h05: Founder's mum asks when the real job starts
garage.headline.h06: Study: nine in ten garages now contain a startup or a startup's boxes
garage.headline.h07: LeaderBored adds a category for "most improved since lunch"
garage.headline.h08: Amazoom Cloud opens a new region; it is a slightly larger warehouse
garage.headline.h09: Startup pivots to AI; was already AI; pivots harder
garage.headline.h10: Neighbours report humming from garage; servers or a very calm bee
garage.headline.h11: Analysts: tokens per second is now a lifestyle metric
garage.headline.h12: NopenAI version numbers now include a decimal, a letter and a mood
garage.headline.h13: Podcast host asks founder about the future; founder asks for a minute, takes forty
garage.headline.h14: Coffee shop bans laptops after seventh "stealth mode" meeting
garage.headline.h15: Intern discovers Ctrl+Z; promoted on the spot
garage.headline.h16: Zlaude and Germini both say "great question" to the same question
garage.headline.h17: Garage lab ships a model; the press release ships first
garage.headline.h18: Chip analysts upgrade garage from "cute" to "concerning"
garage.headline.h19: Power company sends the garage a thank-you card and a warning
garage.headline.h20: Council asks why the garage glows at night
garage.headline.h21: Founder seen at conference in the same hoodie as every other founder
garage.headline.h22: Robotics demo folds 400 towels; refuses one sock on camera
garage.headline.h23: Rival garage across the street switches its lights off to "look focused"
garage.headline.h24: Satellite photos show the garage now has its own weather
garage.headline.h25: Model asks for a day off; HR has never been asked by a model before
garage.headline.h26: Physicists write to the garage: "please stop editing the constants"
garage.headline.h27: Garage valued above several countries; the garage door still sticks
garage.headline.h28: Beta testers say the superintelligence is "very polite about the end of history"

garage.up.intern-d.name: Intern Union of One
garage.up.intern-d.desc: He negotiated a beanbag. Morale has never been higher.
garage.up.gpu-d.name: GPUs on Layaway
garage.up.gpu-d.desc: Pay later, compute now, explain to the board never.
garage.up.closet-d.name: Second Mop Bucket
garage.up.closet-d.desc: Infrastructure doubled overnight. The janitor wants a title.
garage.up.scraper-d.name: Crawl the Crawlers
garage.up.scraper-d.desc: The scrapers now read other scrapers. It is scrapers all the way down.
garage.up.hall-d.name: Hall Gets a Mascot
garage.up.hall-d.desc: An inflatable server on the roof. Visible from the motorway.
garage.up.chips-d.name: Chip Named After the CEO
garage.up.power-d.name: Weather Contract
garage.up.power-d.desc: You prepaid for sunshine. Legal is checking whether that is a thing.
garage.up.robotics-d.name: Robots in Lanyards
garage.up.robotics-d.desc: They now attend all-hands. One asks about equity.
garage.up.orbital-d.name: Constellation
garage.up.orbital-d.desc: So many satellites the night sky shows your logo, slightly blurred.
garage.up.universe-d.name: Universe Has a Universe Lab
garage.up.universe-d.desc: Its scientists are building a pocket universe. Concerning, but productive.
garage.up.desks.name: Standing Desks
garage.up.desks.desc: Nobody stands. The desks are very tall now.
garage.up.second-phone.name: Second Phone
garage.up.second-phone.desc: Twice the tapping surface, half the battery life.
garage.up.coffee.name: Espresso Machine
garage.up.coffee.desc: Italian, chrome, more expensive than the first GPU.
garage.up.sticky-notes.name: Sticky Notes
garage.up.sticky-notes.desc: The roadmap, in four colours, on the fridge.
garage.up.group-chat.name: Founders' Group Chat
garage.up.group-chat.desc: Forty founders, one meme, zero sleep.
